auxiliary_definition_evidence.summary: The model identifies EDHREC rank/saltiness, official card rulings, and provider product/SKU relationships.
Oracle and Printing aliases are Scryfall-generated identifiers; other identifiers refer to named provider namespaces.
The model describes foreign printed content and language-specific metadata, including MTGJSON-generated UUIDs.

first_party_scryfall_policy_search.conclusion: No explicit operation-complete grant was recovered in the bounded first-party review. Inaccessible pages may contain relevant provisions; absence of retrieved evidence is neither permission nor prohibition.

minimum_data_alternative.existing_contract_constraints: The current writer preserves source_values, unknown_fields/unknown_values and parsed context, and a Card requires a name. Retained exact source/parsed/payload/receipt bytes are decision and replay dependencies. Dropping or moving content while keeping unchanged payload hashes/plan bindings would be invalid. A supported exact projection and lawful, replayable source retention location would require review; do not silently strip historical evidence or invent fields.
fields_affected: Card name/normalized_name and printed/type/mechanical fields require field-specific review
minimum_data_alternative.technical_observation: Oracle IDs, MTGJSON Printing UUIDs and Scryfall alias identities could be retained with hashes, locators and necessary structural relationships. Identifiers and factual metadata have different potential rights status from prose/images; this review does not establish their blanket clearance.

operation_scope: evidence review only; no admission decision or source-policy clearance
retention_scope: Policy citation metadata, bounded quotations, internal classifications, field names/counts/hashes and full MIT notice. No whole Scryfall/Wizards policy page, card content, owner inventory, or execution input is added. Raw upstream pages/tool captures remain private.

future_commercial_application.reason: MTGJSON's controlled material can be used commercially under MIT with notices. The exact mixed-content dataset has no established complete commercial grant; paid access/sales/licensing of Wizards-related content would need the relevant additional permission. Permitted advertising/donations for qualifying free fan content do not establish this broader operation.

future_free_public_application.reason: Qualifying original free fan websites have a conditional Wizards permission, but the proposed database/service, exact provider-derived content reuse and third-party chain are not established within that permission. Application behavior and notices must be specified.

private_processing.reason: MTGJSON-controlled processing permission and Scryfall's local-bulk guidance are established narrowly. The exact payload retains Wizards text/rulings/foreign content and other upstream metrics; the reviewed documents do not establish a complete private-processing grant for that content mix. This is an evidence gap, not a prohibition determination.

public_redistribution.reason: No explicit Scryfall grant for public redistribution of the retained facts was recovered, and MTGJSON's MIT grant does not establish underlying Wizards or other contributors' rights. Wizards' Fan Content Policy excludes verbatim republication; a public source-derived database is not established as a qualifying original fan creation.
